title: App iis great - Samsung Watch not so  great
body:
I love the Samsung Health app on my iPhone 7. It tracks everything I want, diet, training. The interface is intuitive. One feature I would like is the abaility to edit the exercises on mthe app and on my watch, removing the ones i never uee. It would also be nice if I could track other exercises. That sadi, the fatal flaw is the watch, mine is a Samsung Active 2. It fails regularly, every few months like clockwork. The backup funnction does not back up all the training data so that means, every few months I just have to reset the watch and lose all that data.The app says you an download your data but Iäm here to tell you thatäs nonsense. You can’t. The downloaded file is a locked zip file and you cannot restore from it so it’s useless. The net result is that there is no point tracking my fitness data with the Samsung watch. Samsung says I should send the watch in for service. From what I see on Amazon and elsewhere, the issues I have with the Samsung watch are all too common. The watch is buggy.. If Samsung is offering to fix it free of charge, I would welcome that. Otherwise I\m not investing another cent in Samsung products. I\m going to get an Apple watch. Friends tell me they are worth the extra money because they just work.

UPDATE 
I’ve gotten myself an Apple watch and life is much better.  It just works so much better than Samsung with an iPhone .  I’m still using the Samsung Health iPhone app, looking for a replacement 

My advice for iPhone users:   Get an Apple watch and find a different health app, one that backs up your data and allows you to download your data.  This one does not.

title: Great potential, but lacks basic Apple Health-integration
body: This app could have been so much better if it wasn’t locked down to a one way synchronization of steps, namely only to Samsung Health. As a user of an iOS device, I would expect an application which is integrated with a premium smart watch as the Galaxy Watch Active 2, to provide the most basic parameters of step and distance synchronization back to Apple Health. Lacking this basic basic feature, along with other parameters such as pulse, sleep, water, nutrients, oxygen, etc, makes the advanced Samsung Galaxy Watch and Samsung Health features unavailable on iOS. Having used the Watch and health-app from Samsung on a Samsung device, there is so much more to make available for an iOS user. Please consider activating these additional features as Apple health already is available.

title: Terrible
body:
To synchronize your Galaxy Watch, you need two apps and you need to synchronize manually. The latter is no biggie per se but everytime the app is updated you’re in for a surprise: If you forget to synchronize for some time, all your not yet synchronized data is gone. I’ve lost data for many days like this, several times. Sometimes you even have to completely reset and re-pair your watch to get it to synchronize again. Loosing all data and settings, of course.

The app is also lacking basic functionality; e.g. it doesn't show GPS tracks, something you’d simply expect from a fitness app in 2020 as the watch does have and use GPS, but probably only for calculatimg distance and speed.

title: Account Reset
body:
The app is great and it is a lot of fun to compeat against my parents, but now, for the third time, my account has been reset! I still have my old profile picture and friends but all of my step tracker history is removed! I had completed a lot of global challenges and I had lots of badges, and this is the third time everything disappears! 
When I open the app sometimes it looks like I’m opening it for the first time! I press login and gets tossed into the app and everything is gone. 
Since it has happened three times now, I hope you guys will fix it! 

7/11 2019:
I had a look at the website you linked but did not find anything useful. After reinstalling the app it worked for a few weeks, but today when I went to my account all of my progress both in all the global challenges I had completed, all of my rewards, all of my step tracker history, EVERYTHING was gone. Again.    
I understand that this is a problem that probably not many people have, making it a hard issue to solve. This is not meant as any offense towards the app, I still love it and it’s developers, it’s just frustrating having to start all over again.
I believe in you guys!
